title: Strength will Rise
lyrics_original: Strength will rise as we wait upon the Lord
We will wait upon the Lord
We will wait upon the Lord (2)
You do not faint You won't grow weary
Strength will rise as we wait upon the Lord
We will wait upon the Lord
We will wait upon the Lord (2)
You do not faint You won't grow weary
You're the defender of the weak
You lift us up on wings like eagles    ||Our God||

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవాకొరకు ఎదురు చూచువారు నూతన బలము  పొందుదురు  వారు పక్షిరాజులవలె రెక్కలు చాపి పైకి ఎగురుదురు అలయక పరుగెత్తుదురు సొమ్మసిల్లక నడిచిపోవుదురు.
bible_verses.english: but those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

bible_verses.telugu: నీకు తెలియలేదా? నీవు వినలేదా? భూదిగంతములను  సృజించిన యెహోవా నిత్యుడగు దేవుడు ఆయన సొమ్మసిల్లడు అలయడు ఆయన జ్ఞానమును శోధించుట అసాధ్యము.
bible_verses.english: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary, and his understanding no one can fathom.

bible_verses.telugu: నీ రాజ్యము శాశ్వతరాజ్యము  నీ రాజ్యపరిపాలన తరతరములు నిలుచును.
bible_verses.english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You that You never grow tired or weary, even when my own strength fails. Today, I choose to pause and wait upon You, placing my worries and exhaustion in Your hands. Renew my heart, Lord, and anchor my hope in Your everlasting presence. Lift me up with Your peace as I trust in Your unfailing love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You that You never grow tired or weary, even when my own strength fails. Today, I choose to pause and wait upon You, placing my worries and exhaustion in Your hands. Renew my heart, Lord, and anchor my hope in Your everlasting presence. Lift me up with Your peace as I trust in Your unfailing love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming and our own energy runs dry, this song reminds us where our true endurance comes from. Waiting on the Lord isn't a passive surrender, but an active, hopeful leaning into His unchanging strength. Because God never grows weary or faints, we can surrender our exhaustion into His faithful hands. As we lift our hearts to Him today, may we feel His quiet peace renewing our souls from the inside out.
